prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Charlotte. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Charlotte for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can give specific names and phone numbers — but to pick the best orthodontists for you I need a little info. Quick questions:

1. Are you an adult or is this for a child/teen? (Some practices focus more on kids; others specialize in adult/esthetic treatment.)
2. What Charlotte zip code or neighborhood do you want to be near? (North/University City, South End, Ballantyne, etc.)
3. Do you have dental/orthodontic insurance (plan name) or a budget range you want to stay within?
4. Do you definitely want Invisalign (clear aligners only) or are you open to braces (metal/ceramic/lingual) if they’re a better option?
5. Any other priorities: evening/weekend appointments, Spanish-speaking staff, accelerate options (AcceleDent), financing plans, treatment speed, or cosmetic focus?

If you want recommendations right away without those details, I can still help: I’ll explain exactly how to pick 3–5 offices to call and give a short script to use on the phone. That checklist will help you find board-certified orthodontists, experienced Invisalign providers, and offices that match your schedule and budget. Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
